item.title: Getting Home After Dark Feels Unsafe for Women in Guwahati
item.description: It is close to 9 PM on a weekday. She waits by a dimly lit roadside in central Guwahati, phone in hand, watching one bus after another disappear from the road. The traffic has thinned, shops are pulling down shutters, and the city is slowly retreating into the night. For her, getting home is no longer routine, it is a calculation of risk. item.title: Packaged Foods in Guwahati Fail to Deliver on Health Claims
item.description: As health-conscious buying grows across Guwahati, an alarming trend has emerged, many packaged food brands are misleading consumers with exaggerated or false claims. From biscuits labelled “whole wheat” to snacks advertised as “no maida” or “diet-friendly,” a closer look at ingredient lists reveals hidden refined flour, artificial additives, excessive sugar, and unhealthy oils. item.title: Gauhati University Professor Gets SAB Research Excellence Award 2025 for Research Work
item.description: GUWAHATI: A professor of Gauhati University has been conferred the SAB Research Excellence Award 2025 for contributions to applied biotechnology. The award has been granted by the Society for Applied Biotechnology, a national-level scientific body based at Karnataka University. ALSO READ: GMC Imposes Fine of ₹10,000 for Illegal Littering and Improper Waste Disposal in Beltola The award has been given to Partha Pratim Baruah in recognition of his research work in plant and environmental sciences.
